items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Finally we got Piggy, then we got Scotty, and we got Earl Jackson... Scotty was doing the arranging

ctx.x: (Inaudible). And we stayed there for six weeks. We were supposed to go there for two weeks, and we stayed there six weeks.

Now, during that time, sometime there in the fall, we had had Earl Jackson, we had many changes in the front line, then, Bob McShann (PHONETIC) was the only one that stayed there. There was a couple of trumpet players. Finally we got Piggy, then we got Scotty, and we got Earl Jackson. Then -for some unknown reason, Earl signed on (inaudible) and left, and we got Bird. And Bird messed up or something, and Max Hammond let him go, got Earl back. Earl had some trouble, and we got Bird back. And then we went -- Jay…

And while we were gone, we left the band under the control of William Scott, the tenor player. He had that real business manner about him, you know. And so when we got back, Bird was in New York. Bird had hoboed, in fact he had come from Chicago, and we didn't even see him.
